The workflow, MeSH decisions, counts, and limitations are in the [search report](/C:/Users/aaron/AppData/Local/Temp/psb-evals/run-fa9b74053cc569e3/lean-optimal-codex-noseed-20260927T152805Z/work/search_report.md).

The final query returned 7,135 records with the 2016-01-24 publication-date cap. No seed PMIDs were available, so validation was limited to MeSH checks, query testing, and sample inspection. The strategy is a draft and should be reviewed by a second information specialist before final use.
